description: This file defines the interface for the Starboard Decode Target module, including types, enums, and functions for handling video/image decode targets, formats, and graphics context providers.

methods.name: SbDecodeTargetIsValid
methods.description: Checks if a decode target handle is valid.

methods.name: SbDecodeTargetIsFormatValid
methods.description: Checks if a decode target format is valid.

methods.name: SbDecodeTargetNumberOfPlanesForFormat
methods.description: Returns the number of planes associated with a given format.
